_comment: Upgrade effects are modular: each effect targets a stat. Ops: 'add' (flat, per level), 'add_pct' (adds value*level to a multiplier) and 'mul' (multiplies by value^level). Final stat = (base + add) * (1 + add_pct) * mul. 'unlock_at' is the lifetime earnings needed before the upgrade appears. max_level 0 = unlimited.

upgrades.name: Better Hand Tools
upgrades.desc: Faster production: every click does more work at each station.

upgrades.name: Polished Finish
upgrades.desc: Higher selling value: a mirror polish and a smart label. Customers pay more.

upgrades.name: Conveyor Motors
upgrades.desc: Beefier belt motors. Cylinders reach the next station sooner.

upgrades.name: Rallying Whistle
upgrades.desc: Keeps clicking worthwhile: each click also gives every machine a burst of extra output.

upgrades.name: Lean Workflow
upgrades.desc: Factory-wide efficiency drive. Every machine runs faster.
